title: Dauntless Unbroken
description: Private realm testing: Ramsgate, Training Grounds, Hunting Grounds and existing Unbroken accounts. Test progress stays separate from the live servers.

sections.title: Welcome to the 1.10.5 test
sections.description: Ramsgate and Training Grounds are available, and Hunting Grounds now starts on demand. Island entry and two Behemoth kills have been confirmed in-game, with XP and inventory saves recorded.

list: Travel to Training Grounds and speak with Trainer Rosk.
Enter a Hunting Grounds island, fight Behemoths and earn weapon XP.

sections.title: Keep your Slayer's belongings
sections.description: Void's gear, quests and previously available islands have been checked in-game. GOLLUM, EkoR and Sheep have also been copied into the private realm with their existing account keys. Full migration still needs more testing.

changes.comment: A fresh start for weapon skills
list: Migrated weapons start at zero weapon XP, shown as level 1 in this version.
Your old Slayer Mastery is preserved separately from weapon skill.
The migration does not reset your existing quests or tutorial progress.
The weapon level display now uses the correct XP tracks instead of placeholder values.

sections.title: Dialogue and early progression
sections.description: Fixed a shared dialogue lookup that showed missing-translation messages for some characters. The first Markus quest and Rosk's Training Grounds dialogue have been checked in-game.

list: The Slayer's Path quest completes, grants 100 Rams and advances.
Training Grounds requests now send you to the training map.
Slayer's Path state is saved in the local test.

sections.title: Still in development
sections.description: This test is separate from the live 1.4.4 servers. Local test progress does not transfer back to your live account.

list: Multiplayer, the remaining islands and Escalations still need testing.
The full quest chain and migration of more accounts still need testing.
